description: Source code for time zone lookup functions within the Abseil C++ library, handling platform-specific time zone retrieval and transitions.

classes.name: time_zone
classes.description: Represents a time zone with methods for name, lookup, transition, version, and description.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the time zone.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup for a given time point.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Performs a lookup for a given civil second.

methods.name: next_transition
methods.description: Finds the next transition after a given time point.

methods.name: prev_transition
methods.description: Finds the previous transition before a given time point.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the time zone implementation.

methods.name: description
methods.description: Returns a description of the time zone.

methods.name: effective_impl
methods.description: Retrieves the effective implementation of the time zone, defaulting to UTC if none is set.
